lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਤ ਚਵਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: merai a(n)tar hoi vigaas priu priu sach nit chavaa raam ||
lines.translation: My inner being blossoms forth; I continually utter, "Pri-o! Pri-o! Beloved! Beloved!"

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਚਵਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: priu chavaa piaare sabad nisataare bin dekhe tripat na aavae ||
lines.translation: I speak of my Dear Beloved, and through the Shabad, I am saved. Unless I can see Him, I am not satisfied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad seegaar hovai nit kaaman har har naam dhiaavae ||
lines.translation: That soul-bride who is ever adorned with the Shabad, meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: daiaa daan ma(n)gat jan deejai mai preetam dehu milaae ||
lines.translation: Please bless this beggar, Your humble servant, with the Gift of Mercy; please unite me with my Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਘੁਮਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: anadin gur gopaal dhiaaee ham satigur vitahu ghumaae ||2||
lines.translation: Night and day, I meditate on the Guru, the Lord of the World; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਵ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਾਰੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham paathar gur naav bikh bhavajal taareeai raam ||
lines.translation: I am a stone in the Boat of the Guru. Please carry me across the terrifying ocean of poison.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਮੈ ਮੂੜ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੀਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur devahu sabad subhaai mai mooR nisataareeai raam ||
lines.translation: O Guru, please, lovingly bless me with the Word of the Shabad. I am such a fool - please save me!

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ਤੂ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਵਡ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham mooR mugadh kichh mit nahee paaee too aga(n)m vad jaaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a fool and an idiot; I know nothing of Your extent. You are known as Inaccessible and Great.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: too aap daiaal daiaa kar melahi ham niragunee nimaaniaa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are Merciful; please, mercifully bless me. I am unworthy and dishonored - please, unite me with Yourself!

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨਮ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮੇ ਹੁਣਿ ਤਉ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: anek janam paap kar bharame hun tau saranaagat aae ||
lines.translation: Through countless lifetimes, I wandered in sin; now, I have come seeking Your Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਮ ਲਾਗਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: daiaa karahu rakh levahu har jeeu ham laagah satigur paae ||3||
lines.translation: Take pity on me and save me, Dear Lord; I have grasped the Feet of the True Guru. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਸ ਹਮ ਲੋਹ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur paaras ham loh mil ka(n)chan hoiaa raam ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the Philosopher's Stone; by His touch, iron is transformed into gold.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਕਾਇਆ ਗੜੁ ਸੋਹਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jotee jot milaai kaaiaa gaR sohiaa raam ||
lines.translation: My light merges into the Light, and my body-fortress is so beautiful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਗੜੁ ਸੋਹਿਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa gaR sohiaa merai prabh mohiaa kiu saas giraas visaareeai ||
lines.translation: My body-fortress is so beautiful; I am fascinated by my God. How could I forget Him, for even a breath, or a morsel of food?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪਕੜਿਆ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: adrisat agochar pakaRiaa gurasabadee hau satigur kai balihaareeai ||
lines.translation: I have seized the Unseen and Unfathomable Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. I am a sacrifice to the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਸੀਸੁ ਭੇਟ ਦੇਉ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur aagai sees bhet deu je satigur saache bhaavai ||
lines.translation: I place my head in offering before the True Guru, if it truly pleases the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aape daiaa karahu prabh daate naanak a(n)k samaavai ||4||1||
lines.translation: Take pity on me, O God, Great Giver, that Nanak may merge in Your Being. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: tukhaaree mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Tukhaari, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਅਪਰਪਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har agam agaadh apara(n)par aparaparaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, is Inaccessible, Unfathomable, Infinite, the Farthest of the Far.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਭਉ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo tum dhiaavahi jagadees te jan bhau bikham taraa ||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on You, O Lord of the Universe - those humble beings cross over the terrifying, treacherous world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਮ ਭਉ ਤਿਨ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikham bhau tin tariaa suhelaa jin har har naam dhiaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, easily cross over the terrifying, treacherous world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਵਾਕਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜੋ ਭਾਇ ਚਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur vaak satigur jo bhaai chale tin har har aap milaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who lovingly walk in harmony with the Word of the Guru, the True Guru - the Lord, Har, Har, unites them with Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਣੀਧਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jotee jot mil jot samaanee har kripaa kar dharaneedharaa ||
lines.translation: The mortal's light meets the Light of God, and blends with that Divine Light when the Lord, the Support of the Earth, grants His Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਅਪਰਪਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har har agam agaadh apara(n)par aparaparaa ||1||
lines.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, is Inaccessible, Unfathomable, Infinite, the Farthest of the Far. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹ ਤੂ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum suaamee agam athaah too ghat ghat poor rahiaa ||
lines.translation: O my Lord and Master, You are Inaccessible and Unfathomable. You are totally pervading and permeating each and every heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਲਹਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: too alakh abheu aga(n)m gur satigur bachan lahiaa ||
lines.translation: You are Unseen, Unknowable and Unfathomable; You are found through the Word of the Guru, the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan dha(n)n te jan purakh poore jin gur sa(n)tasa(n)gat mil gun rave ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed are those humble, powerful and perfect people, who join the Guru's Sangat, the Society of the Saints, and chant His Glorious Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਚਵੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bibek budh beechaar guramukh gur sabad khin khin har nit chave ||
lines.translation: With clear and precise understanding, the Gurmukhs contemplate the Guru's Shabad; each and every instant, they continually speak of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਬਹਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਜਾ ਖੜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa bahahi guramukh har naam bolahi jaa khaRe guramukh har har kahiaa ||
lines.translation: When the Gurmukh sits down, he chants the Lord's Name. When the Gurmukh stands up, he chants the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹ ਤੂ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tum suaamee agam athaah too ghat ghat poor rahiaa ||2||
lines.translation: O my Lord and Master, You are Inaccessible and Unfathomable. You are totally pervading and permeating each and every heart. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevak jan sevahi te paravaan jin seviaa guramat hare ||
lines.translation: Those humble servants who serve are accepted. They serve the Lord, and follow the Guru's Teachings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕੋਟਿ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin ke kot sabh paap khin parahar har door kare ||
lines.translation: All their millions of sins are taken away in an instant; the Lord takes them far away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਦੋਖ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin ke paap dokh sabh binase jin man chit ik araadhiaa ||
lines.translation: All their sin and blame is washed away. They worship and adore the One Lord with their conscious minds.
